Māilladhavala
Jain. disciple of Devasena. rendered his teacher's work Nayacakra into Gāthā form which was in Dohā verses, a. the instance of Śubhaṅkara.
See H. L. Jain, Apabhraṃśa Literature, Allahabad Uni. Studies, I (1925) 178-79; see also under Viśvatattvaprakāśa, Jīvarāja Jain Granthamālā 16, Sholapur, 1964, Intro. p. 81; also Nayacakra.
